confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Ocho Rios and Jamaica food and drink prices. The searches did not return a reliable Ocho Rios figure for cocktails or wine. The food and drink anchors rest on Numbeo-style aggregators for Ocho Rios and Jamaica (cheap meal about $8-9, cappuccino about $3-4, local beer about $1.2-2.6, mid-range dinner for two about $63). I adjusted these upward for resort-town pricing, 10% service charge and 15% GCT. Cocktail and wine are not sourced directly. I set them at roughly 2-2.5 times the beer price, based on typical tourist-venue relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Ocho Rios has very few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are especially uncertain. The 1-star and 3-star anchors are bounded estimates for the Caribbean north coast.
comparable_city_reasoning: Jamaican tourist-resort pricing, comparable to Montego Bay and Negril, and slightly above Jamaica-wide Numbeo-style averages. Accommodation is benchmarked against north-coast Jamaica small guesthouses and mid-range hotels.
